title: AI fusion cuisine: On the latest research article of Jacob Tsimerman
author: Oliver Bräunling

metaphors.title: Human-AI fusion cuisine
metaphors.paraphrase: Mathematics mixed from human and AI contributions can no longer be separated, like a fusion dish.
metaphors.style_hint: A restaurant kitchen with two cuisines on one plate.

metaphors.title: Brains in sandboxes
metaphors.paraphrase: Keeping AI-influenced and AI-free thinking apart would mean plunging brains into sandboxes, which is implausible.
metaphors.style_hint: A sandbox with a brain-shaped lid.

metaphors.title: Dancing in a rain of tears
metaphors.paraphrase: Those responsible dance while young mathematicians whose belief in their own brainpower has shattered and whose meaning of life has evaporated suffer.
metaphors.style_hint: A dance floor in heavy rain.

metaphors.title: A disclosure that is the empty set
metaphors.paraphrase: An AI statement is a Schrodinger's cat that is both AI-free and AI-shaped, and conveys as much as the empty set.
metaphors.style_hint: An empty set symbol in a glass case.

metaphors.title: Test tubes need no log
metaphors.paraphrase: Readers argue lab scientists do not record their use of test tubes, nor do we cite every book we read: AI is just another tool.
metaphors.author: Readers on Bräunling's post
